# Kommo

Kommo CRM is a platform for managing customer relationships, sales pipelines, and business processes.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/kommo/.

## Actions

- **Create Kommo Companies**: Action to add one or more companies into the kommo account.
- **Create Kommo Contact**: Action to create one or more contacts in kommo crm.
- **Create Kommo Lead**: Action to create one or more leads in kommo crm.
- **Create Kommo Tasks**: Action to create a task in kommo crm.
- **List Kommo Companies** (read-only): Action to list kommo companies with various filter options.
- **List Kommo Contacts** (read-only): Action to list contacts in kommo crm.
- **List Kommo Lead Pipelines** (read-only): Action to list lead pipelines in kommo crm.
- **List Kommo Leads** (read-only): Action to list leads in kommo crm.
- **List Kommo Pipeline Stages** (read-only): Action to list stages of a pipeline in kommo crm.
- **Update Kommo Company**: Action to update a single company in kommo crm.
- **Update Kommo Contact**: Action to update contacts in kommo crm.
- **Update Kommo Lead**: Action to update a lead in kommo crm.
- **List Kommo Custom Fields** (read-only): Action to list custom fields in kommo crm.
- **List Kommo Tasks** (read-only): Action to list tasks in kommo crm.
- **Update Kommo Task**: Action to update a task in kommo crm.
